text: No, the whole property was not cleared in 2021. Only about 2.23% of the asset experienced tree-cover loss that year, amounting to approximately 81.3 hectares. This loss was primarily from planted forests, with no native forest loss detected. Additionally, there were small patches of loss under 0.5 hectares, totaling about 37.3 hectares, which were not counted as a significant event. The majority of the property remained unchanged.
